problem: For any $h = 2^{r}$ ($r$ is a non-negative integer), find all $k \in \mathbb{N}$ which satisfy the following condition: There exists an odd natural number $m > 1$ and $n \in \mathbb{N}$, such that $k \mid m^{h} - 1, m \mid n^{\frac{m^{h}-1}{k}} + 1$.
